g.text: PF-Q. Dates on which persistence was worse than W1 for both wind and MSLP
Evidence E (panel directive). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not
representative of all historical dates. Dates selected because persistence's wind and MSLP errors were both larger than W1's. W1 < persistence here by
Qualifying station-date: |persistence error| > |W1 error| for wind AND for MSLP (strict). Share = qualifying / station-dates with complete wind and MSLP. W1 = saved neural-
only next-day output (website scorecard cohort, target dates 2021-11-16 to 2024-12-30); persistence = issue-day observation; climatology = station × month mean 2015-2020;
truth = raw PAGASA observations. Spec: spec/CASE_SELECTION_v4_persistence_override.md. Run persist-v4-20261025T131713Z-3c0ce1.
